title.narrative: Provision of integrated protection Child protection and GBV services for the drought affected children, women and girls through prevention, mitigation of risks and response in Buurhakaba district

description.narrative: ltpgtNWO proposes specialized protection project to enhance access to lifesaving protection services for drought affected populations in BURHAKABA district. The project will deliver an integrated package of Child protection and Gender-Based Violence services to an estimated 3,500 individuals. A significant portion of the target population are IDPs, vulnerable individuals from minority and marginalized clans, female-headed households, children separated from their families, survivors of GBV, and persons with disabilities. These groups continue to face heightened risks and severe barriers to accessing protection services, compounded by stigma and absence of functioning referral systems. Under the Child Protection component, NWO will support 220 vulnerable children and caregivers through family tracing and reunification, alternative care arrangements for UASC and individual case management. Interventions will be delivered by trained child protection case workers embedded in the community. NWO will deploy social workers and in mobile CP teams in drought affected rural areas to provide ⁠⁠Life-saving Protection interventions including assisted referrals and messaging on EORE and PSEA. NWO will establish one Child friendly space in Burhakaba, the CFS will serve as a safe service delivery point for children. NWO will provide specialized case management services to survivors based on their needs 1000 GBV survivors in Support the mobilization of case managers to provide case management service for GBV vulnerable women and girls including GBV survivors, in addition, the survivors of GBV will receive psychosocial support services including emotional support and financial assistance. Survivors in need of clinical support and treatment will be referred to health facilities to receive CMR services.
